lines.text_en: Good afternoon. Do you need help?
Sorry, I don't understand. Please speak slowly.
lines.translation_ru: Извините, я не понимаю. Пожалуйста, говорите медленнее.
accepted: Sorry, I don't understand. Please speak slowly.
I don't understand. Please speak slowly.

lines.text_en: Yes, please. I don't speak English well.
lines.translation_ru: Да, пожалуйста. Я плохо говорю по-английски.
accepted: Yes, please. I don't speak English well.

lines.text_en: No problem. I can help you.
I am lost. Where is the police station?
accepted: I am lost. Where is the police station?
I'm lost. Where is the police station?

lines.text_en: It is near the station. Follow me.
lines.translation_ru: Это рядом с вокзалом. Идите за мной.

lines.text_en: Excuse me, I lost my passport. What should I do?
lines.translation_ru: Извините, я потерял паспорт. Что мне делать?
accepted: Excuse me, I lost my passport. What should I do?
I lost my passport. What should I do?

lines.text_en: You should go to the police station. It is two streets from here.
lines.translation_ru: Вам следует пойти в полицию. Это в двух кварталах отсюда.

lines.text_en: Did anyone find a bag here? I left it on the bench.
lines.translation_ru: Никто не находил здесь сумку? Я оставил её на скамейке.
accepted: Did anyone find a bag here?
Did anyone find a bag here? I left it on the bench.

lines.text_en: A man found a bag and gave it to security. Check there first.
lines.translation_ru: Мужчина нашёл сумку и отдал охране. Сначала проверьте там.

lines.text_en: Thank you so much. You made my day!
lines.translation_ru: Большое спасибо. Вы меня так выручили!
accepted: Thank you so much. You made my day!
